title: Ankhorage Secrets Supabase Vault
summary: Implements server-side secret storage and infrastructure lifecycle integration for Supabase Vault.
purpose: Allow consumers to use Supabase Vault through portable secret-store and infrastructure boundaries without coupling their core logic to Supabase SQL operations.
domain: secret storage and Supabase Vault infrastructure
responsibilities: Store, retrieve, list, and delete secret payloads through the canonical secret-store port.
Expose migration material and metadata required to prepare Supabase Vault.
Plan, reconcile, inspect, and destroy Vault infrastructure through the canonical Infra service adapter.
boundaries: Does not own application authorization, secret naming policy, or credential distribution.
Does not provide a browser-side secret API.
Does not own the portable secret or infrastructure contracts it implements.
audience: Server applications that select Supabase Vault as their secret-store provider.
Infrastructure compositions provisioning the Supabase Vault lifecycle.
useCases: Persist and retrieve an application secret through the canonical secret-store API.
Provision the Vault schema as part of an Infra environment lifecycle.
Inspect or explicitly remove adapter-owned Vault resources.

architecture.role: Provider adapter translating portable secret-store and Infra service boundaries to Supabase Vault operations.
invariants: Supabase-specific SQL and lifecycle behavior remains at adapter boundaries.
Secret payloads are handled only by trusted server-side callers.
Portable consumers depend on published ports rather than this repository's internal types.

security: Vault access requires trusted server credentials and is not safe for untrusted browser clients.
Destructive namespace removal requires an explicitly trusted SQL client.
